description: This file contains shell script functions and configuration for setting up, managing, and tearing down WireGuard VPN interfaces, including peer configuration, address assignment, and dependency management.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_init_config
methods.description: Initializes WireGuard protocol configuration options such as private key, listen port, mtu, and fwmark.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_setup_peer
methods.description: Configures a WireGuard peer with public key, preshared key, allowed IPs, endpoint, and persistent keepalive, and adds routes if needed.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_setup
methods.description: Sets up the WireGuard interface, applies configuration, assigns addresses, and manages dependencies.
